notes: Authoritative machine-readable wage/overtime/exemption params the FLSA tools resolve against. FLSA is the federal floor; a state may exceed it. Resolvers = more-protective of federal vs state: (1) applicable minimum wage = max(US, state); (2) overtime = federal weekly (>40h) ALWAYS, plus any state daily overlay; (3) an employee labeled 'exempt' must earn at least the applicable exempt_salary_threshold_annual = max(US, state) to actually be exempt from overtime -- below it the employee is MISCLASSIFIED and is owed overtime (salary-basis test; a necessary condition for exemption). CA min wage is CPI-indexed (changes every Jan 1) and was live-verified 2026-08-23 against CA DIR; the CA exempt threshold derives from it (2x state min wage full-time). Federal figures are stable statutory/regulatory values. Each figure carries citation + url + effective + a verbatim_anchor for the load-bearing number, matching the legal-corpus citation-fidelity discipline.

US.label: Federal (FLSA floor)
US.ot_anchor: one and one-half times the regular rate
US.source_note: Stable values. Federal minimum wage unchanged since 2009-07-24. EAP exemption salary level = $684/wk ($35,568/yr), the 2019 level restored by DOL's May 2026 technical amendment after the 2024 increase was vacated (live-verified 2026-08-23).

CA.label: California
CA.ot_anchor: one and one-half times ... in excess of eight hours
CA.exempt_threshold_anchor: no less than two times the state minimum wage for full-time employment
CA.exempt_threshold_citation: Cal. Lab. Code §515(a); IWC Wage Orders
CA.source_note: CA minimum wage ($16.90, effective 2026-01-01) live-verified 2026-08-23 via CA DIR. CA exempt salary threshold = 2x state minimum wage for full-time = $70,304/yr for 2026 (derived from the verified min wage). Daily-OT structure per Labor Code 510 is stable.

TX.label: Texas
TX.ot_anchor: one and one-half times the regular rate
TX.source_note: Texas has no state minimum wage above federal, no daily overtime, and no state exemption threshold; defaults to the FLSA floor ($35,568/yr exemption level).
